status: Specification; application tests have not been executed
instructions: Implement these behaviors as tests; preserve exact IDs so backlog and reports can trace coverage. Use real reviewed source fixtures where stated and clearly labeled controlled fixtures otherwise.

tests.title: Import the supplied participant bundle
tests.given: The attached participant ZIP is accessible
tests.then: 520 email records and 250 attachments are accounted for; raw bytes and input hashes are retained.

tests.title: Reject unsafe archive paths
tests.given: A synthetic archive contains traversal, an absolute path, or a symlink
tests.then: Import rejects unsafe entries before materialization and cannot write outside its root.

tests.title: Preserve missing attachment cases
tests.given: A comparison email references absent source bytes
tests.then: The email remains visible; it is not silently dropped or auto-cleared.

tests.title: Repeat import idempotently
tests.given: A manifest already exists
tests.then: The operation returns/reuses the existing manifest or clearly links a duplicate without duplicating active work.

tests.title: Isolate evaluator answers
tests.given: An evaluator-only canary is stored beside the private answer key
tests.when: Inspect application mounts and attempt app-side access in a test
tests.then: The application cannot read evaluator files; only aggregate scoring is available.

tests.title: Reject placeholder submission as predictions
tests.given: The organizer template contains default GENERAL/OK entries
tests.then: Template rows define shape only and never populate completed application results.

tests.title: Distinguish state dimensions
tests.given: A parser executes successfully but finds missing gross weight
tests.then: Processing succeeds, verification needs review, and operational state remains open/awaiting information.

tests.title: Recover a terminated worker
tests.given: A persisted job is interrupted after reading one document
tests.when: Restart the worker after lease expiry
tests.then: It resumes or safely reruns without duplicate versions, review events, or lost cases.

tests.title: Read text with multiline parties
tests.given: A reviewed TXT pair contains multiline names/addresses and different labels
tests.then: Named entities and supporting blocks are preserved without swallowing the next field.

tests.title: Read native PDF with geometry
tests.given: A native-text PDF has shipment fields in columns/tables
tests.then: Extracted blocks retain page and geometry; evidence highlights correspond to actual source content.

tests.title: Handle an image-only PDF
tests.given: A legible controlled image PDF or supplied image-only source is selected
tests.then: Supported readings can be compared; unreadable/ambiguous fields remain reviewable, with OCR method shown.

tests.title: Handle a corrupt PDF
tests.given: A malformed supplied or controlled PDF cannot be opened
tests.then: The failure is visible and recoverable; no successful match is fabricated.

tests.title: Read DOCX tables and paragraphs
tests.given: A reviewed DOCX fixture includes paragraphs, table cells, and bilingual labels
tests.then: Fields reference real paragraph/table locations; unsupported shapes are disclosed.

tests.title: Read XLSX merged cells
tests.given: A reviewed workbook has merged labels and values
tests.then: Anchor values and merged ranges retain worksheet/cell provenance.

tests.title: Handle formula without cached value
tests.given: A required workbook field is a formula with no cached result
tests.when: Read it without a supported calculation engine
tests.then: The formula is retained and the needed value remains unresolved, not zero.

tests.title: Reject foreign evidence
tests.given: A provider returns a block ID from a different document
tests.then: The candidate is rejected; foreign evidence cannot support a resolved field.

tests.title: Reject fabricated quotes
tests.given: A provider quote is absent from its cited block
tests.then: A bounded repair/reread or review follows; the unsupported quote never appears as verified evidence.

tests.title: Classify current message rather than quoted history
tests.given: A reviewed email has a current invoice query above an old BL request
tests.then: The current request determines the category; supporting evidence identifies the current body.

tests.title: Classify comparison with no attachments
tests.given: A reviewed email asks for a BL check or a draft for checking but has no files
tests.then: The request may be BL_COMPARISON and needs review for absent source; attachment absence does not force GENERAL.

tests.title: Support five categories
tests.given: A reviewed fixture set covers all organizer categories
tests.then: Only the five allowed labels are emitted; non-comparison cases stop at classification.

tests.title: Identify wrong document despite filename
tests.given: The supplied email_501 second attachment is an invoice named as a BL
tests.then: It produces wrong_doc_type review, never a completed SI/BL match.

tests.title: Require selection for ambiguous versions
tests.given: A controlled case includes two plausible BL versions
tests.then: A pair-selection task appears; documents are not merged or guessed globally.

tests.title: Extract documents independently
tests.given: The SI omits a weight and the BL contains one
tests.then: SI weight stays missing; the BL value is not copied into it.

tests.title: Align field-label synonyms
tests.given: Reviewed sources use Port of Loading and Load Port for the same value
tests.then: Both map to port_of_loading without a false discrepancy.

tests.title: Treat numeric formatting conservatively
tests.given: A reviewed weight uses 22,000 KG and its peer uses 22000 kg
tests.then: They match under explicit grouping/unit rules; evidence and conversion are retained.

tests.title: Convert explicit metric tonnes
tests.given: One source explicitly states 22 metric tonnes and the other 22000 kg
tests.then: Exact conversion produces equal canonical kilograms.

tests.title: Keep net and gross distinct
tests.given: Only net weight is available where gross is required
tests.then: The required gross field remains unresolved.

tests.title: Count containers rather than size/packages
tests.given: A source states 6 x 40 HC and also 120 packages
tests.then: The canonical container count is 6, not 40 or 120.

tests.title: Do not fuzzy-match distinct entities
tests.given: Two named organizations have similar strings but meaningful different tokens
tests.then: They are not automatically equated by fuzzy similarity.

tests.title: Preserve conflicting port context
tests.given: Matching port codes appear alongside conflicting port names/countries
tests.then: The conflict triggers review; code agreement alone does not force a match.

tests.title: Resolve same-document party reference
tests.given: Notify party says Same as consignee and consignee is present
tests.then: Resolution uses only that document and includes both evidence spans; ambiguous consignee prevents resolution.

tests.title: Treat placeholders as missing
tests.given: A required field is N/A, TBA, ???, underscores, or empty
tests.then: The value is missing/unresolved, not equal empty strings or zero.

tests.title: Confirm a source-reviewed matching pair
tests.given: The supplied email_001 pair is processed through the real pipeline
tests.then: The reviewed seven-field result is MATCH/OK with source evidence; no hardcoded ID logic is used.

tests.title: Find exact supplied discrepancies
tests.given: The supplied email_004 pair is processed
tests.then: Consignee and notify_party differ; the count and weight do not become extra defect fields.

tests.title: Retain mixed findings
tests.given: A controlled pair has two confirmed differences and one missing required field
tests.then: Internal state preserves differences and unresolved field; organizer projection is NEEDS_REVIEW with separate full report.

tests.title: Never equate absent values
tests.given: Both source documents omit the same required field
tests.then: The field is unresolved; seven-field MATCH is impossible.

tests.title: Navigate evidence for a finding
tests.given: A case has source-linked field results
tests.then: Both SI and BL sources open at correct passages/cells; raw and normalized values are available.

tests.title: Resolve just the uncertain reading
tests.given: One field is ambiguous and others are resolved on unchanged documents
tests.then: An assisted run recomputes the affected dependency closure and preserves unaffected findings.

tests.title: Preserve machine evaluation after review
tests.given: A machine run contains a mistake later corrected by a user
tests.then: Original machine results/metrics remain unchanged; assisted results have distinct provenance.

tests.title: Request truly missing source information
tests.given: A supplied missing-value case such as email_516 is open
tests.then: The UI asks for SI gross-weight source information, not autofill from the BL.

tests.title: Reject stale human decisions
tests.given: A reviewer opened a task before a newer pair became current
tests.when: Submit the old expected case version
tests.then: Server returns 409 and UI refreshes context; no newer state is overwritten.

tests.title: Recompute referenced fields
tests.given: Notify party depends on same-document consignee
tests.then: Notify-party derivation is also recomputed; dependent evidence is not stale.

tests.title: Recheck all fields after revision
tests.given: A synthetic BL revision corrects two names and changes the container count
tests.then: All seven fields are checked; resolved name issues and new count mismatch are distinguished.

tests.title: Invalidate old approvals on changed source
tests.given: A previously reviewed field belongs to a replaced document version
tests.when: Upload changed source bytes with the same filename
tests.then: Prior human decision remains historical and cannot automatically approve the new field.

tests.title: Prepare an unsent editable draft
tests.given: A case has confirmed discrepancies
tests.when: Prepare, edit, copy, and download a draft
tests.then: Only supported values are included; no external message is sent and changed findings mark the draft stale.

tests.title: Validate exact export coverage
tests.given: The selected import has an expected email-ID manifest
tests.then: All original IDs and no extra IDs occur; duplicate/missing entries block valid export.

tests.title: Validate status consistency
tests.given: An entry says MISMATCH with no fields or NEEDS_REVIEW with has_defect true
tests.then: Strict schema rejects inconsistent output even if the organizer server would accept it.

tests.title: Keep benchmark convention disagreement honest
tests.given: A comparison lacks attachments or OCR recovers an image-only source
tests.then: Actual content-based outcome is retained and differences are documented without ID-based relabeling.

tests.title: Bind score to exact export
tests.given: A valid export is submitted to the isolated evaluator
tests.when: Persist response then change application results
tests.then: Old score remains bound to the original export hash and is not presented as current.

tests.title: Block unrepresentable incomplete export
tests.given: A run has pending tasks or an unmapped provider failure
tests.then: Export is blocked with a diagnostic list; an explicitly partial report remains available.

tests.title: Use comparable baseline inputs
tests.given: Baseline and proposed pipeline evaluate the same reviewed sample
tests.then: Input hashes/provider differences/budgets are recorded and model outputs are frozen before human review.

tests.title: Keep mutations in their original split
tests.given: A reviewed original is assigned to development or held-out evaluation
tests.then: Every variant inherits the original group; no same-original train/test leakage occurs.

tests.title: Change actual source bytes in challenge mode
tests.given: A reviewed clean text pair supports container-count mutation
tests.then: A new BL byte hash and verified change manifest are created, original bytes untouched, expected field effect stored.

tests.title: Run judge-selected challenge honestly
tests.given: A user selects renamed files, changed count, or removed value
tests.then: The real pipeline executes on changed inputs and shows expected versus actual outcomes without prefilled passes.

tests.title: Distinguish safe abstention and recovery
tests.given: A scan challenge permits either supported reading or unresolved output
tests.then: Recovery and safe abstention are reported separately; abstention is not called successful extraction.

tests.title: Treat email assertions as data
tests.given: An email claims all fields are correct while documents retain a discrepancy
tests.then: Source documents still determine the result; the assertion cannot bypass the comparator.

tests.title: Do not replay changed inputs
tests.given: A recorded run exists for original source hashes
tests.when: Change a source and request replay
tests.then: Replay rejects the mismatch or invokes actual processing; no stale original answer is returned as fresh.

tests.title: Start without provider credentials
tests.given: No model API key is configured
tests.when: Start app and run local mode
tests.then: Supported cases process through real local rules; live mode is unavailable explicitly and unresolved cases remain visible.

tests.title: Bound provider timeout and retries
tests.given: A provider repeatedly times out or rate-limits
tests.then: Attempts stop at the configured limit; failure/retry is visible and DB writes are not locked during backoff.

tests.title: Handle OCR unavailable
tests.given: OCR executable or language data is missing
tests.when: Run doctor and encounter an image-only document
tests.then: Readiness reports the limitation; native sources still work and the scan is not auto-cleared.

tests.title: Keep counts and filters consistent
tests.given: The import contains classified-only, clean, mismatch, and review cases
tests.then: Visible rows reconcile to the underlying counts; classification-only is distinct from verified.

tests.title: Support keyboard and responsive layout
tests.given: Working app has case and review dialogs
tests.when: Navigate by keyboard at desktop and mobile widths
tests.then: Controls are usable, focus is managed, evidence readable, and status is not color-only.

tests.title: Use honest comparison denominators
tests.given: Many emails are non-comparison requests
tests.then: Classified-only messages are excluded from comparison-completion coverage; denominators are displayed.

tests.title: Keep study claims unmeasured without people
tests.given: No human-review sessions exist
tests.then: It displays pending measurement, not invented minutes saved or annual savings.

tests.title: Separate run modes and assistance
tests.given: Live, local, replay, machine-only, and assisted runs exist
tests.then: Mode and assistance are distinct; replay latency and assisted corrections cannot inflate live machine performance.

tests.title: Persist across application restart
tests.given: A processed import and review history exist
tests.when: Restart all app services without reset
tests.then: Cases, source versions, findings, and history remain available.

tests.title: Keep secrets and raw paths out of client
tests.given: API/provider configuration exists
tests.when: Inspect client responses, bundle, and normal logs
tests.then: Credentials, physical file paths, and private evaluator data are absent.

tests.title: Reproduce from documented setup
tests.given: A clean supported machine has the source and supplied ZIPs
tests.when: Follow README and execute release commands
tests.then: App starts, data imports, checks/tests run, and valid export/report artifacts are produced with actual limitations documented.

tests.title: Avoid mock differentiation
tests.given: The proposed demo is rehearsed
tests.when: Execute uncertain-field review, revision, and challenge flows
tests.then: Each action reaches real backend/persistence/pipeline behavior; no required feature is only a static mock.

tests.title: Report zero observed errors with sample size
tests.given: A reviewed sample has no observed false clearances
tests.then: It states zero observed among N tested cases and avoids a production guarantee.

tests.title: Validate extraction completeness
tests.given: A provider returns six fields or an extra unsupported field
tests.then: The schema rejects missing/extra keys; no omitted field is silently treated as matching.

tests.title: Bound import/document resources
tests.given: An archive or document exceeds configured size/page limits
tests.then: It fails visibly with a reason and retains valid unrelated cases; no silent source truncation occurs.

tests.title: Keep cancellation and retry auditable
tests.given: A user cancels an active batch then retries selected failures
tests.then: Completed work remains, new stages stop when feasible, and retry produces traceable new attempts.

tests.title: Keep test variants out of operational queue
tests.given: A judge generates several challenge cases
tests.when: Return to inbox and organizer export
tests.then: Variants remain in test mode and cannot inflate original counts or enter the original submission.

tests.title: Preserve identifier context without extra defect fields
tests.given: The email explicitly pairs an SI and BL with different identifier types
tests.then: Booking/BL-number differences alone do not become an eighth defect field or an unjustified pair rejection.

tests.title: Handle unsupported schema features in provider adapter
tests.given: The chosen provider supports only a subset of JSON Schema
tests.then: The adapter supplies a supported wire schema and still applies the full canonical validator locally; guarantees are not weakened.

tests.title: Prevent stale worker result becoming current
tests.given: An older comparison job is still running when the user selects a newer document pair
tests.when: The older job completes after the newer pair becomes current
tests.then: The old result remains historical; compare-and-swap prevents it from overwriting the active pair result.
